commandments.title: I am the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not have strange gods before Me.
questions: Did I doubt or deny that God exists?
Did I refuse to believe what God has revealed to us?

commandments.title: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain.
questions: Did I blaspheme or insult God?
Did I take God's name carelessly or uselessly?

commandments.title: Remember that thou keep holy the Sabbath day.
questions: Did I miss Mass on Sunday or a Holy Day of Obligation through my own fault?
Did I do unnecessary work on Sunday?

commandments.title: Honor thy father and thy mother.
questions: Did I disobey or disrespect my parents or legitimate superiors?
Did I neglect my duties to my husband, wife, children or parents?

commandments.title: Thou shalt not kill.
questions: Did I kill or physically injure anyone?
Did I harbor hatred, anger, or vengeful thoughts?

commandments.title: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
questions: Did I entertain impure thoughts or desires?
Did I engage in impure actions, alone or with others?

commandments.title: Thou shalt not steal.
questions: Did I steal, cheat, help or encourage others to steal?
Did I damage another's property without acknowledging it?

commandments.title: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.
questions: Did I gossip or reveal others' faults without necessity?

commandments.title: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's wife.
questions: Did I entertain impure thoughts about someone else's spouse?

commandments.title: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's goods.
questions: Was I envious of others' goods or success?
